review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient SSL EOF errors to the retryable set for the Notion warehouse connector, potentially recovering ingestion jobs from mid-TLS handshake drops.
review.reason: The implementation adds two OpenSSL error strings to the retryable error set, while the test assertion is updated to use the new error name. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the warehouse ingestion path.
review.uncertainty: The actual recovery benefit and production impact are not demonstrated; this is an implementation and test update, not a proven benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds SSL-related error strings to a retryable error set, while P1.F2.H1 updates a test assertion. The implementation and test changes are consistent, supporting a single change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds two OpenSSL error strings to the set of retryable errors, while also updating a test assertion to use the new error name.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Notion warehouse connector to recognize SSL EOF errors as transient and retryable, potentially recovering from mid-TLS handshake drops without failing the ingestion job. This could prevent unnecessary ingestion failures when the underlying network or TLS implementation drops the connection unexpectedly, rather than treating it as a permanent failure.
